subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay bounded local images from unmentioned group messages into later mentioned turns, and under which sender/context-visibility and TTL bounds?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes what media from bystanders in a group can be retained and later exposed to model context.

options.title: Approve Bounded Retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

options.title: Keep Text-Only Ambient History
options.body: Document that unmentioned Telegram group media is not replayed later unless the current addressed turn or an explicit reply includes the attachment.

options.title: Require Live Design Proof First
options.body: Keep this issue open until a live Telegram proof demonstrates the failure and a proposed bounded-retention behavior before implementation approval.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages and expose it under existing group authorization and context-visibility rules.

likelyOwner.reason: The most concrete current-main behavior to adjust is the pre-download skip introduced in his Telegram fix, and that decision controls whether unmentioned media is captured at all.
